v4-13.candidate: four hundred golden bells for the two networks, and two groups of pomegranates on one network, covering the two golath of the chothareth above the pillars.
v4-13.close: four hundred golden bells for the two networks, and two groups of pomegranates on each network, covering the two golath of the chothareth above the pillars.

v5-13.display:
there was one voice as they sounded the trumpets, sang psalms, and cried out with one voice to give thanks and praise to the Lord. And as they raised their voice with trumpets, cymbals, and musical instruments and said,
“Give thanks to the Lord, for it is good,
for His mercy endures for ever,”
the house was filled with a cloud of the Lord’s glory.
